goal: Authentication review: sign-in, credential checks, lockout and account recovery.
use: Authentication review: sign-in, credential checks, lockout and account recovery. Use when code handles sign-in, credentials or account recovery.

steps.note: List the flows. Sign-in, sign-up, password reset and sign-out.
Check credential checks. Flag comparisons that are not constant-time or that reveal which field failed.
Check lockout and rate limits. Flag unlimited attempts.
Check recovery. Flag reset links that do not expire or are guessable.
Report. Each flow with file and line, severity and the fix.
